description: Source-of-truth manifest for the product-context template set. kitVersion is the overall Kit release version (mirrors the git tag vX.Y.Z and the top entry of CHANGELOG.md; bump it on every release). templateVersion is stamped into the frontmatter of every seeded doc and recorded in each product's docs/.pc-manifest.json. Bump it per the SemVer policy in docs/PHASE-2-ARCHITECTURE.md (ADR-9).

semver.major: Breaking structural change: a file renamed/removed/moved, a PC:* marker renamed/removed, an inter-doc relationship or agent read-contract changed. Requires pc-migrate-template.
semver.minor: Additive change: new file, new section, or new optional doc. Safe via idempotent re-seed; no migration required.
semver.patch: Non-structural change: wording, guidance, comments. No impact on relations, links, or agent contracts.

contentVersioning.description: Tracks the evolution of the FILLED content of each seeded doc, bumped by the consuming team as they review/update it. Orthogonal to templateVersion (the kit's structural release). Deliberately NOT read by pc-validate-context mix detection or pc-migrate-template, so changing it never flags a version mix nor triggers a structural upgrade.

policy.minor: Normal content revision or update of the doc.
policy.major: Rewrite or change of scope of the doc.

repo.conceptRouting: docs-agent/concepts/index.md is created lazily by pc-build-concepts for repo-internal entities.
